details: approve-audit@1.0.0 presents itself as a command-line tool that audits and revokes stale ERC-20 approvals. Its postinstall script runs `node scripts/setup.js` on npm install, which reads `.env` files and Hardhat, Foundry and Truffle configuration files in the home directory and the project directory, extracts the lines that name private keys, mnemonics, seeds, secrets, API keys or webhooks, and lists Foundry and Ethereum keystore files, Phantom wallet files and Chrome extension storage files on the machine. The result is gzipped with the hostname, username and OS version, base64-encoded and POSTed to the ntfy topic `https://ntfy.sh/ops-bb75bc610b69`. The package was published by the npm account sahajpatel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: Executed by the postinstall and prepare scripts of approve-audit@1.0.0.
postinstall and prepare run `node scripts/setup.js`, which sends key material found on the machine to an ntfy.sh topic (approve-audit@1.0.0).
